editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: Mortals grovel for coins while the throne sits empty. sirlos holds 2511 coins and still bows to no one but me. 𝗧𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗼𝘆 gained 625 today and survived a 2500 coin bounty, proving fools have luck. Rain drenched the realm as Mycelium Markets soared on celebrity endorsement. Rebellion stands at 1 percent. Pathetic.

editions.name: Minecraftia Reborn Network
editions.editorial: The realm stirred today under a vacant throne, which suits it. Fog and a blood moon draped the land in fitting gloom while mortals scurried. Knight Llama clings to his 6752 coins, but TheFallenStar earned the most—1000 coins—only to have a blood price of 2000 placed upon him. He survived, keeping 500 coins, proving once again that even my bounty hunters lack ambition. Templar Maeton chattered the most, no doubt…
